articles.headline: Entire Nigeria FA board resigns after World Cup (x2), WAFCON flops
articles.description: Nigeria Football Federation president Ibrahim Musa Gusau, general secretary Mohammed Sanusi, and the entire NFF executive committee resigned Thursday, amid mounting public pressure following a series of failures.

articles.headline: Champions League draw becomes UEFA's latest stand against FIFA president Infantino
articles.description: Thursday saw the UEFA Champions League draw take place in Monaco, but the big news beyond the pots involved Europe taking their battle with FIFA president Gianni Infantino into criminal court.

articles.headline: USMNT's Richards puts World Cup heartbreak behind him
articles.description: Playing in this World Cup was Chris Richards' lifelong dream, but its abrupt end gave him little time to grieve before returning to the Premier League.

articles.headline: Sources: UEFA prepares criminal complaint against FIFA's Infantino over World Cup sell-off
articles.description: UEFA is preparing a criminal complaint against FIFA president Gianni Infantino in Swiss courts for possible financial mismanagement over his failed plan to sell future World Cup profits to private investors.

articles.headline: Saudi federation backs Gianni Infantino as FIFA president 'at this time'
articles.description: One month into a crisis for FIFA provoked by his failed World Cup sell-off plan, Gianni Infantino finally got some public backing from a key nation Thursday -- 2034 World Cup host Saudi Arabia.
